notes: Extraction, reserves, processing and logistics details come from general knowledge, not the evidence; reserves life is not stated.

mineral_product.value: Salt (rock salt, ice melters), sulfate of potash plant nutrients, and magnesium chloride

extraction_route.value: Underground rock salt mines (Goderich, Cleveland, Winsford) and solar evaporation of brine at Great Salt Lake

beneficiation_processing.value: Crushing, screening and packaging of salt; brine evaporation and processing into sulfate of potash and magnesium chloride

delivery_radius_logistics.value: Distribution primarily across North America and the U.K. from production and packaging facilities in the U.S., Canada and U.K.

product_specification_permits.value: Consumer, industrial, chemical and agricultural grade products, including Safe Step ice melters and crop-quality plant nutrients
